comments:
#### Why was this issue closed?

Thank you for your contribution to our project. This issue has been closed due to its limited upvotes and recent activity, and insufficient feedback for us to effectively act upon. Our priority is to focus on bugs that reflect higher user engagement and have actionable feedback, to ensure our bug database stays manageable.

Should you feel this closure was in error, please create a new issue and reference this one. We're open to revisiting it given increased support or additional clarity. Your understanding and cooperation are greatly appreciated.

review_comments: This looks wrong: as far as the client is concerned, Electron was launched, it's main js ran w/o errors. It might have done things and we could even try testing it's main context.

What I tried to fix was that the `CRBrowser.connect(chromeTransport, browserOptions)` promise never resolved

Inside `CRBrowser.connect` is this code: `await session.send('Browser.getVersion');` which never resolves

![code](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/23744935/159759854-12b987d3-a75d-4722-804b-9d9801b870ea.png)


What would be another solution to this problem?

@SimonSiefke My only concern is that a seemingly successful launch should not lead to exception. I.e. we should handle early exit of Electron gracefully. Giving a more detailed hint would require me to look at the code and think for a while - it ain't easy task.
